name: Gawloyes Milirose
source:
Grand General of the Gha'alian Forces, Gawloyes Milirose, is an intimidating, fierce, and clever elf. Born in 746V age has made him no less fierce or hesitant to plunge himself personally into battle, traits that have certainly not gone unappreciated among his subordinates. He is a wildly celebrated elf often single handedly charged with guiding the direction of his country; the 'true king' of Gha'alia, some are even so bold to claim.

Despite having achieved the very highest status among his people he remains ambitious. A certain unnerving perseverance and unrelenting aggression inspire ferocity in the many who follow his lead, where his wisdom and largely successful record inspire faith and loyalty. For this, he regards his position with utmost pride and should the day ever come, he by no means intends to retire peacefully.(from official site)
